correctness.rationale: The exact residual state has k pendant and k(k-1)/2 core edges, so first-step p_k=2/(k+1) and F_k=(2zF_{k-1}+(k-1)F_{k-2})/(k+1). Summing yields (1-t^2)J_t-2zJ=1 for J=tH; integration gives the PGF. Darboux transfer at t=1, with the t=-1 term lower order uniformly near z=1, gives mod-Poisson asymptotic F_n(z)=2^(z-1)n^(z-1)/Gamma(z+1)(1+O(1/n)); differentiating yields displayed moments and CLT. Parity and X=0 boundaries follow exactly. Independent recurrence/power-series checks through n=4, and n=7 normalized probabilities agree.
